claim: UKMTO or JMIC reports at least one attack, explosion, mine strike, projectile or drone hit, armed hostile approach, boarding or seizure involving a merchant vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, the Persian Gulf, the Gulf of Oman or the Arabian Sea that took place on Friday 27 November 2026 (00:00–23:59 Gulf time).

runs.scenario: If the only qualifying incident is reported at 19:59:30 UTC on 27 November (23:59:30 Gulf time), one reader could count it because '00:00–23:59' includes the entire final minute, while another could exclude it because the exact event-window endpoint is 23:59:00.
runs.yes_requires: At least one merchant vessel must suffer a qualifying attack, explosion, mine strike, projectile or drone hit, armed approach involving weapons fire or a boarding attempt, boarding, hijacking, or seizure in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf, Gulf of Oman, or Arabian Sea (including waters around Socotra) on 27 November 2026 Gulf Standard Time (UTC+4). UKMTO or JMIC must report the incident. Delaye
